description: Defines an abstract class AlarmCondition for alarm rule conditions, including JSON serialization info, validation, and schedule handling.

classes.name: AlarmCondition
classes.description: Abstract class representing a condition for alarm rules, with JSON serialization, validation, and schedule logic.

methods.name: hasSchedule
methods.description: Checks if the alarm condition has a schedule that is not an AnyTimeSchedule.

methods.name: requiresScheduledReevaluation
methods.description: Determines if the condition requires scheduled reevaluation based on schedule or expression.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates that scheduled reevaluation expressions are only used with simple alarm conditions.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Abstract method to get the specific type of alarm condition.
